title.zh: Automattic's board forces CEO Matt Mullenweg into leave of absence
title.en: Automattic's board forces CEO Matt Mullenweg into leave of absence

current_state.zh: Automattic's board voted to place CEO Matt Mullenweg on a paid leave of absence, a move he publicly disputed in a company-wide Slack announcement, raising questions about the future of WordPress and Automattic.
